data: all_data2
PCA Testing for Turbidity, PPFD, Temp, Chlorophyll
```{r}
response_variables_noStable <- response_variables_data %>% select(-Stable) %>% drop_na()
```

```{r}
PCA <- prcomp(response_variables_noStable, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE)
summary(PCA)
```

```{r}
PCA1_graph <- fviz_pca_biplot(PCA, xlab = "PC1 (36%)", ylab = "PC2 (30%)", repel = TRUE, col.var = "black", col.ind = "gray", title = "", label = "var") + theme_base()
```
PCA Testing for Turbidity, PPFD, Temp, Chlorophyll, ForelUleColorCategory, BottomDepth_ft
```{r}
all_data2$ForelUleColorCategory <- as.integer(all_data2$ForelUleColorCategory) 


PCA_data2 <- select(all_data2, Turbidity_NTU, Temp_C, DO_mg.L, DO_percent, PPFD, CorrectedConcentration_ug.L, BottomDepth_ft, ForelUleColorCategory) %>% drop_na() 
```

```{r}
PCA2 <- prcomp(PCA_data2, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE)
summary(PCA2)
```
```{r}
PCA2_graph <- fviz_pca_biplot(PCA2, xlab = "PC1 (34%)", ylab = "PC2 (27%)", repel = TRUE, col.var = "black", col.ind = "gray", title = "", label = "var") + theme_base() 
```

```{r}
PCA1_graph|PCA2_graph
```
